نَشُوحٌ A little water. (S, K.) Abu-n-Nejm says, describing asses, “حَتَّى إِذَا مَا غَيَّبَتْ نَشُوحَا
” (S, L,) meaning Until, when they had taken into their bellies a little water: or نشوح signifies a drink less than suffices to satisfy. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
